name: manage_sections
description: Manage section lifecycle operations through one facade. Mutations save working draft source only and never update the live page; a human must Publish or Update live in the Manual editor. This facade supports reorder and delete operations.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: Uncanny Page Builder canvas page ID. Pass this when the user provides a canvas_id or a page_id known to be an Uncanny Page Builder canvas. For ordinary WordPress page URLs or names, resolve the target first; do not assume any page_id is editable. Omit to use the current page when a canvas is active.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Lifecycle operation. This slice recognizes reorder and delete.

parameters.name: section_ids
parameters.description: Full ordered section ID list for reorder operations.

output.description: Plain-text lifecycle result or validation error with NEXT STEP guidance.
